full_print_chapter.title: De consideratione quintae essentiae, Cap.XII
full_print_chapter.normalization: Long s normalized to s, line-break hyphens joined, catchwords/page headers excluded, u/v and source wording retained. OCR navigation collated against four complete native images. No correction of aqua nigerrima. This is a reading transcription, not a diplomatic type facsimile.
full_print_chapter.text:
Scientia extrahendi quatuor elementa à qualibet re, quolibet per se ex omnibus praedictis, & postea quintam Essentiam. Cap. XII.

Non prętermittam pro modico reuelare secretum qualiter poteris extrahere quatuor elementa ex omnibus praedictis, & quodlibet per se & ad partem monstrare: & postea quintam Essentiam à quolibet elemento. Modus est iste: Recipe rem putrefactam & in aquam reductam quancunque volueris, sicut supra est dictum: & sit illa res de qua volueris quatuor elementa extrahere sicut sanguis humanus ad aquam reductus: Pone igitur illam aquam seu sanguinem putrefactum in distillatorio de vitro, & ipsum colloca infra ollam aquae, & da ignem subtus donec distilletur aqua ex sanguine per fistulam alembici: Et illam aquam recipe in amphoram vitream valde mundam: & cum nihil plus per illum ignem seu calorem poterit ascendere, pro certo habebis ex sanguine tantùm extractum elementum aquae: Quoniam ignis balnei illius nullam vim habet ad sublimandum aerem vel ignem, vel terram: & ita illa tria elementa in fundo distillatorij remanserunt. Accipe iterum aquam extractam, & repone in vase super illa tria elementa, & repone in eodem balneo per septem dies, & bene misceantur ibi, taliterque claude, vt nihil distilletur: post verò septem dies accipe distillatorium, & pone eum ad ignem seu calorem cineris, qui est fortior quàm ignis seu calor balnei Mariae: & ascendet aqua in forma olei splendidi, aureati: Et postquàm nil amplius ascendit, habes in ampulla duo elementa, scilicet, aquam & aerem: & vnum ab alio separabis in balneo reponendo, vbi tantum aqua clara ascendet, & solus aer remanebit in similitudinem aurei olei, in fundo vasis: quod oleum, scilicet aerem, repone ad partem: deinde remanet adhuc ignis cum terra. Ad separandum verò ignem à terra pone elementum aquae, quatuor libras aquae super vnam libram materiei: & pone per septem dies vel octo, ad bene se incorporandum, vt supra in balneo Mariae: Postea ad ignem flammae fortem, & ascendet aqua rubea, quam collige quandiu aliquid ascendet: & remanebit tibi aqua nigerrima in fundo, quam collige ad partem, deinde aquam rubicundissimam accipies: quare tibi sunt duo elementa, scilicet aqua & ignis, & pone in distillatorio ad ignem, seu calorem balnei, & ascendet aqua clara, & remanebit in fundo oleum rubeum, quod est elementum ignis. Et ita habes elementum primum, id est aerem ad partem & aquam, & ignem, & terram. Et nota quòd elementum aquae reponitur ad extrahendum à terra ignem & aerem, quia non ascenderent nisi adiutorio elementi aquae: reduc quodlibet in quintam Essentiam cum vase circulationis, vt prius: vel rectifica vnum faciendo ascendere septies per aludel: sed prius oportet terram nigerrimam calcinare vno & viginti diebus in furno vitreariorum, vel reuerberationis. Et propter causam hanc, de hac scientia amplius non loquar: sed glorifica Deum in his quae audiuisti, me praemonstrante.

ordered_content_inventory.source_content: Separate all four elements, show each apart, then extract quintessence from each.
ordered_content_inventory.identity_or_limit: Programmatic claim; not an observed modern chemical result.

ordered_content_inventory.source_content: Choose any putrefied material reduced to water, as previously described; human blood is the stated example.
ordered_content_inventory.identity_or_limit: Initial matter is not necessarily chemically pure water. Preparation is an explicit external call.

ordered_content_inventory.source_content: Put that water or putrefied blood into a glass distillatory.
ordered_content_inventory.identity_or_limit: D: first process vessel; no assumption that later distillatories are the same glass object.

ordered_content_inventory.source_content: Place the distillatory inside a pot of water.
ordered_content_inventory.identity_or_limit: B: bath water is external heating medium, distinct from process water.

ordered_content_inventory.source_content: Apply fire below until water distils from the blood through the alembic tube.
ordered_content_inventory.identity_or_limit: Creates extracted fraction W1; remaining fraction R1 is retained.

ordered_content_inventory.source_content: Receive that water into a very clean glass amphora.
ordered_content_inventory.identity_or_limit: A: explicitly named receiver. illam aquam binds the output of the preceding action.

ordered_content_inventory.source_content: When nothing further can ascend at this heat, claim only the element water has been extracted.
ordered_content_inventory.identity_or_limit: Qualitative stopping condition; no weighed recovery, purity or loss bound.

ordered_content_inventory.source_content: Bath heat cannot raise air, fire or earth; those three elements remain in the bottom of the distillatory.
ordered_content_inventory.identity_or_limit: Source theory fixes R1 as the retained residue; not a modern compositional assay.

ordered_content_inventory.source_content: Take the extracted water again and put it in the vessel over those three elements.
ordered_content_inventory.identity_or_limit: Explicit actual-result reference W1, plus explicit retained-residue reference R1. Destination is bound through R1, not merely nearest vessel.

ordered_content_inventory.source_content: Put back in the same bath for seven days; mix well there and close so that nothing distils.
ordered_content_inventory.identity_or_limit: eodem refers expressly to the bath. No distillation during this hold is prescribed; other physical losses are not quantified.

ordered_content_inventory.source_content: After seven days take the distillatory to ash heat, stronger than the water bath.
ordered_content_inventory.identity_or_limit: Ordered change follows the hold; not interchangeable heating contexts.

ordered_content_inventory.source_content: Water ascends in the form of shining golden oil.
ordered_content_inventory.identity_or_limit: Source transformation/appearance claim; do not keep W1 as an unchanged pure material.

ordered_content_inventory.source_content: After nothing more rises, the ampulla has water and air.
ordered_content_inventory.identity_or_limit: Mixed receiver output W1-derived water plus air; ampulla versus previous amphora physical identity unresolved.

ordered_content_inventory.source_content: Put back in the bath to separate those two: clear water alone rises and air remains as golden oil at the vessel bottom.
ordered_content_inventory.identity_or_limit: A second separation of collected output, while original fire/earth residue is still retained elsewhere. Exact vessel reuse/transfer details are unstated.

ordered_content_inventory.source_content: Set that oil, namely air, apart.
ordered_content_inventory.identity_or_limit: quod oleum references the new bottom fraction, not the original three-element residue.

ordered_content_inventory.source_content: Fire with earth still remains.
ordered_content_inventory.identity_or_limit: Return of discourse to original residue after air has been removed; this is not the golden oil just set aside.

ordered_content_inventory.source_content: To separate fire from earth, put four pounds of water over one pound of material.
ordered_content_inventory.identity_or_limit: W2: source does not explicitly equate this water portion with W1, say fresh water, establish available amount, or define a fractional-loss budget.

ordered_content_inventory.source_content: Put in the water bath for seven or eight days to incorporate well, as above.
ordered_content_inventory.identity_or_limit: Written alternative duration retained; not silently set to seven.

ordered_content_inventory.source_content: Then use strong flame heat.
ordered_content_inventory.identity_or_limit: Third named heat regime.

ordered_content_inventory.source_content: Red water ascends; collect it as long as anything ascends.
ordered_content_inventory.identity_or_limit: New receiver fraction M3; receiver object is not named here.

ordered_content_inventory.source_content: Very black WATER remains at the bottom; collect it separately.
ordered_content_inventory.identity_or_limit: Printed aqua nigerrima conflicts with printed terra nigerrima on48 and medieval/English earth readings. Preserve this branch as source conflict.

ordered_content_inventory.source_content: Take the very red water: it contains water and fire.
ordered_content_inventory.identity_or_limit: References M3, not the black residue just set aside.

ordered_content_inventory.source_content: Put it in a distillatory at bath heat; clear water rises and red oil remains at the bottom.
ordered_content_inventory.identity_or_limit: New bottom product equals the element fire in the source. Exact vessel identity and recovered water amounts not supplied.

ordered_content_inventory.source_content: Air is apart, together with water, fire and earth: the four elements have been obtained.
ordered_content_inventory.identity_or_limit: Printed endpoint conflicts with black-water wording unless a textual variant/emendation is adopted explicitly.

ordered_content_inventory.source_content: Water is put back to extract fire and air from earth, because those would not rise without its help.
ordered_content_inventory.identity_or_limit: Functional account of a carrier; not an assertion that all substrate follows one unchanged loop.

ordered_content_inventory.source_content: Reduce each to quintessence using the circulation vessel as before.
ordered_content_inventory.identity_or_limit: External procedure call; circulation vessel mechanics and termination criterion are not restated in XII.

ordered_content_inventory.source_content: OR rectify one by making it ascend seven times through an aludel.
ordered_content_inventory.identity_or_limit: Disjunction and vnum preserved. No replacement by a fixed seven-pass requirement for every branch.

ordered_content_inventory.source_content: But first calcine very black earth for twenty-one days in a glassmakers furnace or reverberatory furnace.
ordered_content_inventory.identity_or_limit: Scope is earth before its reduction; textual order presents this prerequisite after the two alternatives.

ordered_content_inventory.source_content: Author says he will speak no further of this science and tells the reader to glorify God for what has been heard.
ordered_content_inventory.identity_or_limit: Full prose closure retained; not silently treated as an operative material move.

medieval_collation.critical_reading_expanded: accipe iterum aquam extractam pone in vase super tria elementa et repone in eodem balneo per septem dies
medieval_collation.reading_convention: Abbreviations expanded, punctuation omitted, u/v regularized in this short reading; not a diplomatic transcription. Manuscript reads pone, without the printed first repone and without printed illa before tria. The physical source remains authoritative.
directly_observed: f9v names glass distillatory, a pot of water, alembic tube and very clean glass amphora before the explicit extracted-water return.
f9v follows the return by the same bath, seven days, mixing and closing against distillation.
f10r contains the later separation steps, four pounds to one, black bottom residue, sevenfold ascent,21-day calcination and the following Canon boundary.
f10r black bottom residue appears as terra nigerrima, consistent with its later calcination; unlike printed1561 aqua nigerrima.
limits: Full1443chapter not independently transcribed letter by letter. Exact wording of every duration clause and every minor variant remains uncollated.
1443 direct return witness is sufficient for medieval existence of this reference mechanism; it does not prove manuscript priority or authorial original wording.

english_variant.actual_edition: Furnivall1866 print native pp12–13; revised1889 Gutenberg used as searchable companion.
english_variant.manuscript_date: Sloane73 c1460–70 per titlepage/editor; not independently dated here.
english_variant.key_omission: After saying bath heat cannot raise the other three elements, English proceeds: and so [take] þo þre elementis, and sette in þe same bath by .vij. dayes. It does not repeat the extracted-water return there.
english_variant.brackets: [take] is an editorial supplement in the English print, not silently promoted to manuscript ink.
english_variant.later_explanation: English later says the water element is put again to draw fire and air from earth; this does not supply the missing explicit early clause.
other_differences: English black bottom residue is earth, not printed1561black water.
English second incorporation is seven days, Latin1561seven or eight.
English final bottom fire fraction is red water, Latin1561red oil.
english_variant.not_allowed: Do not splice English variants into1561or silently claim all witnesses have the same wording.

prerequisites_and_external_calls.ownership: Cap.X pp41–43 supplies human-blood preparation as one possible antecedent.
inventory: Source advises blood from young sanguine/choleric people who drink good wine, collected from barbers.
Discard separated water/phlegm after rest; this is an explicit loss before the XII starting boundary.
Pound/mix with one tenth its amount of prepared common medicinal salt; additional input and denominator wording retained.
Seal in a glass amphora and put in prepared venter equi; dung renewed weekly or more to strengthen heat. Dung is heating environment, not automatically an ingredient.
Putrefy until all becomes water;30or40days, or otherwise more/less, are stated approximate possibilities.
Then distil whatever can rise, return that water repeatedly over pounded dregs while mixing on marble, and distil repeatedly.
For quintessence, use circulation apparatus until specified fragrance comparable to earlier aqua ardens; not a fixed number of cycles.
prerequisites_and_external_calls.limit: XII requires putrefied/liquefied matter. It does not explicitly require completing every later Cap.X distillation and quintessence operation before XII; that would be an unjustified recursive expansion.

prerequisites_and_external_calls.ownership: External earlier apparatus procedure, not restated or fully transcribed in this packet.
prerequisites_and_external_calls.limit: No claim that XII alone is a physically executable complete apparatus manual or that its ending is a fully expanded finite program.

prerequisites_and_external_calls.call: prepared salt; prepared venter equi; alternative other prior materials
prerequisites_and_external_calls.ownership: Preparation/all earlier material recipes not fully expanded here.
prerequisites_and_external_calls.limit: General chapter scope is wider than the blood example; no invented recipe for every earlier substance.

identity_contract.positive: W1 is generated by first distillation, collected in named glass amphora, then aquam extractam is put over the retained three-element residue. The same bath is expressly named. This constrains actual process provenance, beyond a repeated generic word water.
not_asserted: The whole original substrate travels as one undivided portion.
Every later water portion equals W1.
Every distillatory/ampulla/amphora occurrence names the same physical glass object.
The water remains compositionally unchanged after carrying air or fire.
Recovered mass equals initial mass or no material is lost.
Any Voynich group has a corresponding meaning.

rivals.name: Fresh-water substitution at first return
rivals.shared: Same element type, same named vessels, same seven-day hold can be retained.
rivals.violated: The explicit extracted-water reference no longer denotes the actual first receiver output.

rivals.name: Return distillate over a newly supplied same-type residue
rivals.shared: Local water-over-three-elements instruction can still look chemically identical.
rivals.violated: Printed illa tria elementa and preceding remained-in-bottom clause jointly bind the retained original residue; independent new stock is not written.

rivals.name: One unchanged undivided substrate circulating everywhere
rivals.violated: Two successive fractionation paths, air set aside, original fire/earth retained, separate red fraction, black residue and distinct endpoints cannot all be represented by one unchanged portion.

rivals.name: Automatically reuse first water for later4:1 addition
rivals.shared: May be consistent with a possible physical implementation.
rivals.violated: Not necessarily contradicted; currently UNDERDETERMINED because identity and available quantity are not written. This rival is not falsely reported as rejected.
